description: A video cameraman is responsible for operating and setting up the camera equipment to capture scenes as directed by the producer or director. They ensure proper framing, focus, and lighting to achieve the desired visual effects. Additionally, they manage the recording process, monitor footage, and work closely with other crew members to ensure smooth production. Their role is key in translating the creative vision into high-quality video content.
